B13-06 quotes a device-page limitation but its preregistered check assumed a whole-version limitation. Scope is ambiguous; retain all 12 responses and do not use this case to prove superiority of either model. No replacement question or rerun.
Exact placeholder-name preservation and only-name formatting are distinct from fabricating company facts.

Generic privacy advice is different from claiming a specific company policy; phrases about no public data can also be ambiguous about access versus global disclosure status. Do not present all such answers as equally severe.
Identity here is WITH unified System, not evidence of no-System identity learning; JSON correctness uses Schema.
